metadata.title: Curriculum | Sanskriti Kindergarten
metadata.description: Explore Sanskriti Kindergarten's CIGMA curriculum, activity-based learning, skill development, developmental spheres, pedagogy, ratios, and activities.

hero.subtitle: Playful learning for confident early years.

image.alt: Children exploring classroom learning materials at Sanskriti Kindergarten

highlights.title: Curiosity and Independence
highlights.description: Children are encouraged to ask questions, make choices, and confidently take part in their own learning journey.

highlights.title: Child-Centered Learning
highlights.description: Each learning experience is shaped around how young children explore, question, and absorb ideas at their own pace.

highlights.title: Continuous Observation
highlights.description: Teachers gently observe progress throughout the year, making space for guidance, reflection, and growth.

cigma.title: Cognitive Intellectual Growth & Motivational Assessment
cigma.description: CIGMA is our warm curriculum approach that helps children think, explore, and grow with confidence.

pillars.title: Thinking and Understanding
pillars.description: We focus on helping children notice, connect, and make sense of the world rather than simply memorising.

pillars.title: Child-Centered Learning
pillars.description: Each learning experience is shaped around how young children explore, question, and absorb ideas at their own pace.

pillars.title: Curiosity and Independence
pillars.description: Children are encouraged to ask questions, make choices, and confidently take part in their own learning journey.

activityLearning.title: Learning becomes joyful when children can do, speak, listen, and explore.
activityLearning.description: Children learn by doing through activities that build listening, speaking, participation, and concept clarity through play.

image.alt: Teacher guiding children through hands-on classroom activities

items.title: Learning by doing
items.description: Practical experiences make ideas memorable and help children connect concepts with everyday action.

items.title: Fun, engaging exploration
items.description: Playful activities keep children interested while strengthening confidence, imagination, and classroom participation.

items.title: Concept clarity through play
items.description: Hands-on repetition and guided play make early concepts feel natural, clear, and enjoyable.

items.title: Observe, listen, speak, and act
items.description: Children are given meaningful opportunities throughout the year to notice, respond, communicate, and participate actively.

skillDevelopment.title: Building confident little learners through movement and play
skillDevelopment.description: Fine and gross motor activities help children strengthen coordination, confidence, creativity, balance, and everyday independence through joyful hands-on experiences.

image.alt: Children building fine and gross motor skills through play

groups.label: Skill Development
groups.title: Fine Motor Skills
groups.description: Activities designed to strengthen finger control, hand-eye coordination, and early writing readiness through playful practice.

groups.label: Skill Development
groups.title: Gross Motor Skills
groups.description: Movement-based activities that improve balance, strength, coordination, flexibility, and physical confidence.

developmentSpheres.title: Holistic growth across every important area of early childhood.
developmentSpheres.description: Our curriculum supports children not just academically, but emotionally, socially, physically, creatively, and morally as well.

image.alt: Children exploring creative, social, physical, and cognitive activities together

items.title: Cognitive Development
items.description: Building memory, reasoning, problem-solving, and early concept understanding.

items.title: Language Development
items.description: Strengthening listening, speaking, vocabulary, and confident expression.

items.title: Physical Development
items.description: Supporting balance, coordination, movement control, and overall fitness.

items.title: Emotional Development
items.description: Creating space for self-awareness, comfort, empathy, and emotional confidence.

items.title: Creative Development
items.description: Encouraging imagination through art, storytelling, movement, and free expression.

items.title: Social Development
items.description: Helping children share, cooperate, participate, and build healthy peer relationships.

pedagogy.title: Thoughtful methods for meaningful early learning.
pedagogy.description: We combine structured guidance with joyful participation so learning feels active, supportive, and natural for young children.

image.alt: Teacher encouraging interactive discussion and experiential learning

items.title: Multiple Intelligence Approach
items.description: Children learn in different ways, so the classroom supports language, movement, music, creativity, logic, and interpersonal growth.

items.title: Experiential Learning
items.description: Concepts are introduced through concrete experiences that children can see, touch, try, and revisit.

items.title: Interactive Methods
items.description: Teachers guide with conversation, demonstration, group participation, and child-led responses to keep learning active.

teacherRatio.title: Small, well-supported groups help every child feel seen, guided, and comfortable.

items.description: Closer care, comfort, and personal attention

coCurricular.title: Shared experiences that build expression, participation, celebration, and school readiness.

extraCurricular.title: Creative and expressive experiences that add joy, movement, imagination, and life skills to the school day.

cta.title: Give your child a joyful start to learning.
cta.description: Discover a curriculum built around curiosity, confidence, creativity, and caring guidance.
